class.name: CubismModelImporter
class.brief_description: Imports project-local Cubism models through the Redot editor.
class.description: Editor-only importer registered automatically by [GDCubismPlugin]. Stock Redot 26.2 does not discover compound [code].model3.json[/code] suffixes on a fresh filesystem scan; use Project > Tools > Import Cubism Model for a separately saved resource, or Prepare Legacy Cubism Model for an engine-managed import. Wait for texture/audio scanning to finish. The importer provisions owned textures and persists resource dependency edges; engine import metadata remains owned by Redot.

method.name: import_model
method.description: Imports [param source_file] to a contained project-local [code].res[/code] or [code].tres[/code] destination and returns a Redot [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. Missing optional files warn unless [param strict_optional_files] is true. Source assets are preserved; invalid inputs are not saved as a successful model.

method.name: import_model_with_options
method.description: Imports to [param destination] using validated import [param options]. On success saves the resource, replaces its cached resource data and refreshes the editor resource index. Use this for explicit output resources; [method import_source] uses Redot-managed source import instead.

method.name: import_source
method.description: Asks the editor filesystem to import the original project-local manifest using this importer. Preserves existing Cubism import options and refuses a source assigned to another importer. Used by legacy-scene preparation. Reopen and save legacy scenes afterward so their hidden resource dependency edge is stored. This method is unavailable in exported games.

members.member: Import option controlling the manifest expression catalog. Disabled expressions are not added to the imported runtime catalog.
Import option controlling declared manifest motions. No extra motion files are discovered by scanning neighboring folders.
Imported default mask limit: Low (0), Medium (1) or High (2). Preferred model nodes inherit it unless explicitly overridden.
Provision textures and shader selection consistently for premultiplied alpha. Change this import option and reimport/reload instead of changing a node shader alone.
Treat missing optional inputs as failures. Malformed or unsafe inputs fail regardless of this option.
